chunks: And separate yourselves, O you sinners, this day.
ai.seo_question: What does the command 'separate yourselves' mean in Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate separation (firqah) between the faithful and the sinners, emphasizing that the 'criminals' (al-mujrimun) will be distinct from the believers in their final abode. It serves as a divine command for the disbelievers to recognize their own distinct group identity on Judgment Day, contrasting with the unity of the righteous. This separation underscores the concept of 'al-wala' wa al-barra' (loyalty and disavowal) as a key criterion for salvation.
